findings.evidence: weighted stop-out rate 45.7% of trades are killed by the −0.5% stop
findings.hypothesis: require higher-timeframe trend confirmation and/or greater momentum separation at entry to reduce the share of trades that stop out

findings.evidence: mean max adverse excursion -0.69% exceeds the −0.5% stop; mean max favorable excursion is only 0.58% — a near-symmetric swing against a tight stop
findings.hypothesis: entries are taken into normal two-sided intrabar swings wider than the stop; selectivity (seller-exhaustion / displacement-from-VWAP / regime) that raises MFE relative to MAE should improve net expectancy

findings.evidence: adverse excursion -0.69% is larger in magnitude than favorable 0.58% — the entry edge is negative before the stop even acts
findings.hypothesis: the momentum entry has no directional edge over the hold window; entry-quality filters (not exit tuning) are the lever

note: measured on genuine 1m bars (simulated fills); drives governed hypothesis generation — not a profitability claim
